summary: Iteration 26 — Non-persistent frontend regression for the new AGR certificate-number format and sample previews. All 9 requested checks PASSED. (backend returns 404); legacy 'AZR-GEM-000015-26' correctly rejected by new CERT_RE regex as invalid format. Design-time guarantee (name/kode edits do not change already-issued number) verified by design per main-agent note; NOT exercised live to respect the data-safety freeze.

VerifyPage.tsx sample-mode date is hard-coded to '2026-08-11'. Not a bug (design-only mock) but worth noting for future consistency with the backend sample date.
